    4. Login: create the same user as on bc1-bc3 (/coord/secrets/bc-linux.env), or write /coord/secrets/bc-demo.env with exactly BC_DEV_USER=... and BC_DEV_PASSWORD=...
    5. Do NOT add bc-demo to /coord/machine/allocation.json: it is outside every lease pool.
    6. Re-run: bun scripts/bc-demo-setup.ts
